claude.label: Claude Code
planMode: --permission-mode plan; the plan comes to NEEDS YOU (spike N).
liveModel: Next turn, or now by interrupting and resuming (spike B).
todos: TaskCreate and TaskUpdate drive the cue list (spike D).
resume: claude --resume with the same session id (spike E).
computerUse: Interactive only: use it through Talk, one session at a time; background turns (-p) cannot.

resume: codex resume with the same session id (spike K).
